messages:
Priya (PM): quick check — we need to pick an order for investing in isolation work. customer asks keep coming for VPC/on-prem, but infra is pushing capacity improvements. thoughts on a staged approach?
Marcos (Eng): agree we can't do everything at once. my preference: land core capacity/throughput wins first, then layer private deployment features. keeps latency/cost under control for hosted users.
Jen (Sales): practical reason: a few enterprise deals are contingent on private deployment. revenue risk if we delay too long. can we do a thin private MVP earlier?
Alex (Infra): thin private MVP still needs network/KMS + audit logs. that touches infra surface area a lot. parallel work possible but will add context switching.
Priya (PM): propose: split into 3 increments — 1) Capacity & autoscaling primitives (low-friction wins), 2) Private MVP (VPC + basic KMS + audit surface), 3) Full Private (air-gapped, HSM, compliance). each gated by launch criteria and RICE check.
Liza (SRE): gating proposal: GA for increment 1 requires sustained p99 latency < X ms for 95% of routes and backlog < Y. otherwise private won't be stable.
Sam (Research): from model/quant side, quantization + batching is high impact with low incremental effort; that should be in increment 1 to reduce cost for all customers and free capacity for private engineering.
Marcos (Eng): agree. also note some private features can reuse components (routing, billing, model pinning). plan to factor common layers into 1.
Priya (PM): quick RICE sketch for prioritization — open to adjustments:
```
Option A (Capacity-first): Reach=7 Impact=8 Confidence=7 Effort=4 -> Score=(7*8*7)/4=98
Option B (Private-MVP-first): Reach=4 Impact=9 Confidence=6 Effort=6 -> Score=(4*9*6)/6=36
Option C (Parallel small bets): Reach=6 Impact=8 Confidence=5 Effort=8 -> Score=30
```
Jen (Sales): RICE helps. sales asks could push private-mvp sooner but number shows capacity-first gives better ROI. we have 2 hot deals that might accept partial private (VPC only) if timeline is short.
Alex (Infra): can we formalize "partial private" as VPC networking + allowlist + KV encryption—minimal surface to unblock those deals? estimate 3 sprints.
Marcos (Eng): 3 sprints is optimistic but doable if we reserve a small squad. risk is context switch from core runtime work. suggest dedicated squad for private-MVP while core team finishes batching/quant work.
Priya (PM): sounds like a path: prioritize capacity + batching (inc 1), spin up a focused 2-3 sprint squad for "VPC-light" (inc 2a) to unblock deals, continue full private feature development in inc 3. launch criteria and metrics for each increment: define them now and tie to a go/no-go.
Liza (SRE): add observability gates: token-level tracing enabled, error budget delta < 1.5x during rollout, and automated rollback hooks.
Sam (Research): also add quality guardrails for quantization (eval set pass rate > 95%) so we don’t degrade outputs.
Jen (Sales): ok, I'll flag the two deals and convert them to "VPC-light ok" if we get a 6-week timeline. helps prioritize.
Marcos (Eng): next steps: action items — (1) infra to draft VPC-light scope (Alex), (2) runtime to quantify batching wins + timeline (Marcos/Sam), (3) PM to write RICE-backed PRD and launch gates (Priya).
Alex (Infra): creating an RFC doc, will share by EOD. ops-bot: created task ticket #INF-1423 for VPC-light scope.
Priya (PM): thanks — let's reconvene Fri for a quick decision. :thumbsup:
